verdict.line: You lose if Darius lands E and stacks Hemorrhage to enrage before you have items; you win if you survive to Trinity Force and out-farm him into the late game.

brief.thesis: Darius wins this lane on raw mechanics: his passive Hemorrhage stacks to 5 and then enrages him with massive bonus AD, and his E (Apprehend, range 535, cooldown 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s) both pulls you into range and passively shreds your armor. The 49.1% win rate over 165 games reflects that Camille has no early answer to that pull-and-stack pattern, but her W (Tactical Sweep) outranges his entire kit at 610, so this is a lane you survive on poke and farm, not one you fight.

theirWindow.what: At 5 stacks Darius enrages and gains massive bonus AD. If his E is also up, he can pull you in with Apprehend and combo you down before you can respond. Back off and reset stacks rather than trading through them.

yourWindow.when: right after his E (Apprehend) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: His E cooldown is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s, so once he uses it — on you or to clear wave — he has no way to force range for a long stretch. Step up and poke with W (Tactical Sweep, range 610, cooldown 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) since it outranges his Q (Decimate) and auto-attack range entirely.

start.why: Runs in 51.7% of games at a 72.1% pick rate. The extra AD and lifesteal proc help you win short auto-attack trades before he lands E, and the sustain matters since you'll be soaking bleed damage.

boots.why: Picked in 78.2% of games. Darius's entire kit is physical damage — his Q, W-empowered auto, and passive bleed all get reduced, which matters more than the tenacity from Mercury's Treads since he has no hard CC besides the E pull itself.

core.why: First item in the most common build path (52.6% pick among that path). Grants the stats and empowered auto damage that let you actually threaten a trade once you have it, roughly levels 9-11.
Second item in the same path. Adds sustain and wave clear so you can shove and reset instead of matching him in extended fights before you're fully itemized.
Completes the most-played path (44% win rate over 50 games). The bleed-damage mitigation and healing directly counter Darius's Hemorrhage stacking and his true-damage ultimate.

situational.when: you're behind and need to survive his all-in instead of racing damage
you're ahead and winning sustained trades, since it accelerates your cooldowns further

runes.keystoneWhy: Runs at a 50% win rate with 20.5% pick, the most-played page for this matchup. The proc heal directly offsets Darius's Hemorrhage bleed in extended trades, and the bonus health scales your effective tankiness against his true-damage ultimate.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport posts the highest win rate (53.8%) of the three combos run in this matchup, and Teleport fits the farm-and-scale plan since it lets you reset for items and still make a play elsewhere on the map while Darius is stuck trying to solo-kill you in lane.

playing.title: Stay outside 535 range
playing.detail: That's the range of Darius's E (Apprehend). Standing just beyond it denies his only way to force a fight before you're ready.

playing.title: Poke with W, not autos
playing.detail: Tactical Sweep has 610 range versus his melee kit. Land the outer-half slow and extra damage from safety instead of trading autos where his passive stacks punish you.

playing.title: Track your own Hemorrhage stacks
playing.detail: Once you're near 5 stacks, disengage. Darius enrages at max stacks with a massive AD spike that turns even skirmishes into kills.

playing.title: Save E for a wall punish
playing.detail: Hookshot (cooldown 16/15/14/13/12s) needs a wall to leap from and knocks up on landing. Hold it for when Darius overextends near terrain rather than using it just to close distance.

playing.title: Respect level 6 all-ins
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine deals true damage scaled by your Hemorrhage stacks. Play around your HP threshold once he hits 6, since a low-stack execute can come from nowhere.

playing.title: Delay Q recast for max value
playing.detail: Precision Protocol's second cast hits far harder if you wait between attacks. Use the delayed recast when you're safely poking, not mid-trade where the window gets interrupted.

playing.title: Prioritize farm over kills pre-9
playing.detail: You have no reliable way to punish him until Trinity Force. Match this to the matchup's defensive shape — take free CS, decline 50/50 trades, and look to scale.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and win-rate figures above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (165-game Camille vs. Darius sample). The mechanical reasoning — why each window opens, when to poke, when to back off — is my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not stand in range of Darius’s (E) pull! Try to focus on farming lane as Camille has better potential late game than Darius.
